title: Four Hundred Words, One Chair
subtitle: 写作与作品 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 写作与作品（生活与学习·写作与表达）
meta: 主题语境：写作与作品（生活与学习·写作与表达）　|　核心词汇：composition　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 composition 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my teacher ① set a composition on a subject nobody had chosen, and she said the setting was the whole of the lesson. The ② composition, meaning the writing and not the subject, ran to four hundred words and stayed that length; composition, she said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how little it says twice.

Every ③ composition in that pile had the same margin, and the ④ composition at the end, meaning the one she read aloud and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever asked for twice. Composition, my mother said, is nine parts margin and one part somebody willing to begin; my teacher said the beginning is the part that fills the page.

My grandfather meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the composition of the soil was the whole of the garden, meaning the mixture and not the writing. The ⑥ composition, meaning the mixture and not any of that, is the only thing in a garden that everybody depends on and nobody sees; composition, he said, is either something you set or the only word that means both a piece of writing and a mixture. She said the mixture is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ composition had become a line in a mark book, and the book had become an argument about the margin. The ⑧ composition of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in June, was one subject and thirty years of beginning; composition, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to begin. He said the beginning was never mentioned.

The ⑨ composition I remember is the one at the end, which was read aloud in 1977 and is still described as the shortest in the school. A ⑩ composition, my mother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being read; every composition, she said, is a mixture that has agreed to look like a page. She said the mixture was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 作文（指那篇写出来的文字本身，与那个题目相对）
C. 固定搭配：set a composition 布置一篇作文
D. n. 作文（指那一摞本子里每一篇）
E. n. 作文（指末尾那一篇）
F. n. 构成；成分（指土壤的构成）
G. n. 作文（指记分册里提到的那一篇）
H. n. 构思；布局（抽象总称）

items.q: set a composition on a subject nobody had chosen
The composition, meaning the writing and not the subject
the composition of the soil was the whole of the garden
the composition had become a line in a mark book
The composition of the whole thing
A composition, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: set a composition 意为“布置一篇作文”，1963 年老师布置了一篇谁都没有选过的题目的作文。
composition 意为“作文”，指那篇写出来的文字本身而不是那个题目，它写了四百词。
composition 指那一摞本子里每一篇作文，每一篇都留着同样的页边空白。
composition 指末尾那一篇（她朗读的那一篇），是唯一有人要过两次的。
composition 意为“构成、成分”，祖父说土壤的构成就是那个园子的全部，指的是那种混合而不是那篇文字。
composition 为另一个义项，指那种混合而不是那篇文字，是园子里人人都依赖、却无人看见的东西。
composition 意为“作文”，指记分册里提到的那一篇，到 1971 年这篇作文成了记分册里的一行。
composition 意为“构思、布局”，老师六月写道，整件事的构思是一个题目三十年的开头。
composition 意为“作文”，我记得的是末尾那一篇，1977 年朗读过，至今仍被说成全校最短的。
composition 为抽象总称，母亲说一篇作文是唯一会因为被朗读而变好的东西。
